related.description: macOS app that allows the control of Spotify and AppleMusic/iTunes music playback from the menu bar.
Screensaver inspired by Apple’s inbuilt iTunes Screensaver. It can display Artwork by Spotify or last.fm Profile Data.
Spotify & Apple Music in your macOS menu bar
A simple Spotify lyrics viewer menu bar app for macOS in Swift 3
📃 Get lyrics of currently playing Spotify song so you don't sing along with the wrong ones and embarrass yourself later. Very fast.
